coverr.purpose: primary free stock video B-roll search and download (no API key)
coverr.search_contract: Search with one or two English keywords, e.g. 'misty mountain' or 'rain window'. Coverr matches every term, so a three-word phrase such as 'misty mountain sunrise' returns zero hits; the client narrows a long phrase automatically and records the query that actually matched in the clip's search_query. Prefer non-premium hits; the search response carries no mp4 URL, so the detail endpoint is fetched per clip.

pexels.purpose: free stock video B-roll candidate research and download
pexels.search_contract: Search with one or two English keywords, e.g. 'misty mountain'. Prefer orientation=portrait for 3:4 delivery. A long phrase is narrowed automatically and the effective query is recorded per clip.

pixabay.purpose: free stock video B-roll candidate research and download
pixabay.search_contract: Search with one or two English keywords, e.g. 'ocean waves'. A long phrase is narrowed automatically and the effective query is recorded per clip.

mixkit.purpose: curated free stock video B-roll (manual browse/download; no stable public search API)
mixkit.search_contract: Browse https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/ and download clips manually into 03_images_生成图片/broll-approved/.

life_of_vids.purpose: small cinematic free stock library (manual download)
life_of_vids.search_contract: Browse https://www.lifeofvids.com/ and download CC0 clips manually.

free_nature_stock.search_contract: Browse https://freenaturestock.com/ and download clips manually.

vidsplay.purpose: small free HD stock library (manual download)
vidsplay.search_contract: Browse https://www.vidsplay.com/ and download clips manually.
